seed: Gap mode used to read the space under the pointer from edges in a window around it, so pointing into the band between two lines of a heading measured a few pixels sideways between letters that were not level with the pointer at all (the user, 2026-10-13). It now walks out along the pointer's own column and row and reads text as whole lines. Stage one points into the band between two lines of a display heading at two spots and checks both read the same line gap, running vertically through the pointer. Stage two does the same between two lines of body copy.

steps.note: THE FIRST CLAIM: the pointer sits in the dark band between 'Screenshots' and 'recordings', near the upper line and between two of its letters, and the gap lit under it runs from the bottom of the upper line to the top of the lower one
THE SECOND CLAIM: close to the lower line, above the top of a short letter, it is still the same line to line gap, not the space down to that letter
THE THIRD CLAIM: between two lines of body copy the gap runs from the bottom of the descenders above to the top of the ascenders below
